t6: The Dhaka Bypass Expressway project represents a landmark achievement in China-Bangladesh cooperation, bringing together Chinese investment, technical expertise, and experience with local Bangladeshi knowledge and resources.
t7: Led by Sichuan Road & Bridge Group (SRBG) as the majority partner with a 60% stake in the project company, Chinese contribution encompasses financing, engineering expertise, advanced construction methods, and knowledge transfer that is helping to transform Bangladesh's infrastructure landscape.
t8: This partnership demonstrates how the Belt and Road Initiative is creating practical benefits through infrastructure development. t65: Introducing revolutionary road construction techniques to Bangladesh
t67: One of the most significant Chinese contributions to the Dhaka Bypass Expressway project has been the introduction of semi-rigid pavement technology to Bangladesh. This innovative construction method combines the flexibility of asphalt with the strength of concrete to create a more durable and longer-lasting road surface.
t68: SRBG has not only implemented this technology but has provided comprehensive training to Bangladeshi engineers, both through specialized programs in China and hands-on training at the project site. This knowledge transfer will have lasting benefits for infrastructure development throughout Bangladesh.

t81: Part of the Belt and Road Initiative
t82: The Dhaka Bypass Expressway stands as a flagship project of the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) in Bangladesh, representing practical cooperation that creates tangible benefits for the local population and economy.
t83: As highlighted at the Third Belt and Road Forum, this project exemplifies how Chinese expertise and investment can work within local frameworks to deliver infrastructure that meets international standards while respecting local needs and conditions.
t84: By improving connectivity not only within Bangladesh but also to the broader regional transportation network, the expressway contributes to the core BRI goal of enhancing interconnectivity across Asia.
